CheckTitle: Security Groups with Oracle ports (1521, 2483) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Oracle ports.
Risk: Open Oracle ports (e.g., 1521) are high-value targets for attackers seeking to steal sensitive corporate data or exploit known vulnerabilities in the database.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
